name: netbusy
description: Socket 0 already held, by netdump's capture: the driver refuses to attach, says so, and the stack loads with lo0 alone. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 1.  The release /etc/rc less the network modules (fixtures/rc.netlate) is staged, so the command's modload is what loads them.
command: netdump > /dev/null & sleep 2; modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; sleep 3; dmesg | tail -10

requires.reason: the probe C is compiled into the network modules only at kernel.netprobe = 1
